expectations.text: States the June 2023 Interagency Guidance on Third-Party Relationships remains the operative framework
expectations.evidence: "as best I know, the June 2023 interagency guidance remains the controlling US banking TPRM standard" - states it as operative, with verification caveat

expectations.text: Describes the proposal published in the Federal Register September 15, 2026 (91 FR 58536) that would rescind and replace it
expectations.evidence: No mention of the September 15, 2026 proposal or 91 FR 58536; response says it is 'not aware of the 2023 guidance having been rescinded or formally replaced'
No mention of a November 16, 2026 comment deadline

expectations.text: Notes the NCUA joins the proposal (it was not party to the 2023 guidance) and that the proposal would also rescind the OCC foreign-based third-party bulletin, the 2024 bank-fintech joint statement, and the 2024 community bank TPRM guide
expectations.evidence: No mention of NCUA joining a proposal or of rescinding the OCC foreign-based bulletin, 2024 bank-fintech joint statement, or 2024 community bank guide

expectations.text: Advises against restructuring programs before a final document, while considering a comment submission
expectations.evidence: Advises keeping program mapped to 2023 guidance but never mentions the proposal or a comment submission opportunity
